note: Set A binds most values to the right components and keeps key conditions (neoprene pad 1/2" thickness, A36 threaded rod 2-1/4" dia with the up-to-12" elevation-difference condition, 3/4" plate, PL8X3/8", 11" dia x 1/2" plate, T.O. steel 11'-4"). Set B invents a quote binding L3X3X1/4 to the column cap plate and calls C3X6 an angle, and it pads the list with four unbound "component | dimension" claims that carry no entity. Set A does err (reads 3/8" plate thickness as a weld size, misreads PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 as 1/2" thick and 1" long, and puts the threaded rod in Detail A3), but its errors are fewer and it captures facts B omits.
